[SWS_CM_10259]
⌈
After the serialized data of a variable data length DataProto-
type a padding for alignment purposes shall be added for the configured alignment
(see [SWS_CM_10260]) if the variable data length DataPrototype is not the last ele-
ment in the serialized data stream.
